The '''Eastern Watchwoods''' was the name given to the eastern part of the forest located on the northern edge of the [[Gormak Lands]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Voss]], at the foot of the [[Mountain/Legends|mountain]] where [[Voss-Ka]] was located. The [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic's]] [[Camp Talanis]] was located on the eastern edge of the Eastern Watchwoods, while the [[Koss Overlook]] marked the border between the Eastern and [[Western Watchwoods]].<ref name="TOR" />
